name: Sleepwalker
source:
"Hello there, I'm your doppelganger."

Sleepwalker is a fan-made psychological horror retelling of the famous Creepypasta, Jeff The Killer. With themes of existential dread,  subvert expectations with something you only thought you knew. Nothing is what it seems. Don't believe anything you see or hear.

[From [url=https://a-ngel-boy.itch.io/sleepwalker-ch1-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你好，我是你的二重身。”

《Sleepwalker》是一部同人心理恐怖作品，重新演绎了著名网络怪谈《杀手杰夫》。故事围绕存在主义恐惧展开，颠覆你对那些自以为熟悉之物的认知。没有什么如表面所见。不要相信任何看见或听见的东西。

[摘自[url=https://a-ngel-boy.itch.io/sleepwalker-ch1-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
